desc:
Miyako Yoshika's theme.  
  
    Although a jiangshi, she is basically a zombie, so I tried to make a fittingly exotic intro. But as I was writing it I noticed that the intro actually has a pyramid feel to it.

    And that’s when it occurred to me: isn’t this less a zombie intro, and more a mummy intro?

***

[**ZUN's comment**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Ten_Desires/Music#:~:text=Rigid%20Paradise) on the track Rigid Paradise.
